slots.rationale: R28, leaning per C8: the p1 box (both issues) says 8:30-9:00 PM; the newest issue's Portuguese page, OLRF's own Thursday notice, says 7:00-7:20 PM before the 7:30 Mass. I lean to 7:00-7:20: it is the newer, service-specific notice, it fits the parish's pattern of confession just before each Mass, and 8:30 is when the prayer group starts. The website lists no OLRF Thursday times. If both are real, the reviewer can edit in the second.
